sources.title: Confidence Estimation via Auxiliary Models
sources.summary: Learns a true-class-probability confidence target with an auxiliary model; evaluated for classification and semantic segmentation.
sources.relevance: Supports label-derived confidence supervision rather than assuming confidence or agreement equals utility.

sources.title: Assessing Reliability and Challenges of Uncertainty Estimations for Medical Image Segmentation
sources.summary: Dataset calibration can coexist with poor subject-level calibration; studies auxiliary quality estimation alternatives.
sources.relevance: Requires patient-group stability checks and local benefit diagnosis, not interpreting all-image gate means as mechanism quality.

sources.title: Confidence Calibration and Predictive Uncertainty Estimation for Deep Medical Image Segmentation
sources.summary: Studies CE versus Dice training, model ensembling and segmentation-quality prediction for calibration.
sources.relevance: Calibration can differ from hard Dice; candidate must be judged on fixed raw/native metrics and separately report ensembles.

inference: Detached ungated reference-gain labels and balanced informative cells are this stage candidate design, not established RACE evidence or a novelty claim.
